chunks: May Allah make us and you among those who strive with their hearts for the abodes of the virtuous, by His mercy.

key_terms.الْأَبْرَارِ: The virtuous; plural of barri, referring to righteous people who attain high spiritual stations.
key_terms.بِقَلْبِهِ: With his heart; indicating internal, spiritual striving rather than merely physical action.
key_terms.يَسْعَى: To strive, run, or hasten; implies active effort and devotion.

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to strive with the heart for the abodes of the virtuous?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in the 'Magnificence of the Creator in birds' chapter, reflects the Shia emphasis on *al-abrar* (the righteous) as those whose inner spiritual striving (*sa'y*) aligns with divine mercy. It underscores the concept that true piety is not merely ritualistic but involves an active, heart-centered journey toward elevated spiritual stations, a theme central to Nahj al-Balagha's ethical teachings.
